title: Going to Work and to the Airport
text:
Anna goes to work by bus. The bus stop is near her house. The bus is green and very big. Every morning, the bus leaves at seven o'clock.

On Friday, Anna goes to the airport. She takes a taxi because she has a big suitcase. Her plane to Rome leaves at ten. She is happy because she likes to travel.

questions.text: How does Anna go to work?
Where does Anna go on Friday?
Why does Anna take a taxi on Friday?
options: She has a lot of luggage to carry
She wants to see the city

questions.text: What can we say about Anna's feelings for travel?

vocabulary.definition: a large vehicle that carries many people along a road
a place where planes take off and land
a bag with a handle that you use to carry clothes when you travel
a car that takes people where they want to go, for money

paragraph_translations: Anna jeździ do pracy autobusem. Przystanek autobusowy jest blisko jej domu. Autobus jest zielony i bardzo duży. Każdego ranka autobus odjeżdża o siódmej.
W piątek Anna jedzie na lotnisko. Bierze taksówkę, bo ma dużą walizkę. Jej samolot do Rzymu odlatuje o dziesiątej. Jest szczęśliwa, bo lubi podróżować.
